name: tax_half_baisa_midpoint_law
description: DOCUMENTED DIVERGENCE CLASS #2 pinned: 5% VAT on a 0.090 base is EXACTLY 4.5 baisas — the core's deterministic decimal law rounds half away from zero to 5. The device computed this on a binary-noisy double and (for this input) rounded DOWN to 4; that representation-dependent outcome is an accident of the old pipeline, not a contract. Bounded at +/-1 baisa per rounded quantity, midpoints only. Grand 0.095.
